scope: Read-only audit of frozen compiler wave; no compiler changes, build, execution or performance claim.
conclusions: SDK producers already jointly audit final SDK HIR before emitting libraries.
Persistent .poda summary comes from LLVM and carries selector-call facts, not return body certificates.
External factory calls and SDK getter tables are intentionally rejected by current body-bound consumers.
SDK-only canonical-cache proofs cannot cross the app boundary without complete app+SDK symbol/global-writer reconciliation.

proposal.status: git apply --check passed; not applied, compiled, hooked, or production-enabled
proposal.initial_scope: Allocation/Phi/null/scalar constants/comparisons plus ABI-matched nonrecursive CallStatic closure over actual body witnesses; reject runtime calls, caches, globals, symbol addresses, field loads/stores, dynamic calls, strings, ARC and duplicate symbols.
proposal.expected_eligibility: Not measured without compiler instrumentation/build. Ascii/Utf8 const encoder cache closures deliberately ineligible; Base64 field loads ineligible. No claimed size improvement.
next_changes: After freeze release, add helper as test-only and test complete dependency audit and body replacement rejection.
At sdk_module.rs joint-final-HIR audit point, export candidate signatures, full possible return CID union including null and producer-body closure identity into SdkLibrary.

Publish certificates only after emitted SDK objects are finalized; bind to exact sdk_key, profile/target/policy, object hashes and compiler proof schema. Reject old/missing/corrupt records by falling back to unknown.

Introduce strict versioned .poda return records or separate proof sidecar; carry symbol linkage and independently physical class/table identity. All references must resolve to same cache closure, never declaration-only ancestry.

At lib.rs prune_program_hir load, reconcile app symbols/COMDAT with every certified dependency; conflicting or shared/interposable symbols deny certificate. Validate exact linked object manifest and table pairs.
Keep imported facts in distinct certified inventory; do not relax nominal_classes guard. Imported static calls require exact signature matching and unknown fallback.
Feed same validated inventory into hir_summary_with/prune_hir and LlvmEmitter provenance. Recompute local app SCC dependencies against imported terminal proofs, preserving local recursive rejection.
Enable only after actual cached SDK cold/warm and copied/modified SDK differential validation. Then measure OFF/ON generated code, linked retention, executable bytes and quiet runtime separately.
required_tests: Positive fresh AllocObject or AllocList with valid body witness, supported Phi union and explicit null path; CallStatic acyclic closure with exact ABI.
Negative duplicate getter/factory symbol, COMDAT body replacement, mismatched ABI/target/policy/object hash/cache key, CID collisions, missing or conflicting whole tables, selector hash collision.

Negative canonical cache child, global load/store, function/global address operand, pointer exposure, opaque runtime call, unknown static dependency, cyclic dependency, partial closure and stale immutable-body witness.
Actual ordinary Dart const ASCII/UTF8/Base64 stays conservative until cache/global proof is implemented; no fixture expectations that incorrectly treat those as exported.
Cold then warm same compiler/cache; copied SDK same contents; custom SDK changes getter allocation/null/dependency body and independently updates external source replacement; old sidecar rejected.
VM and official AOT oracle vs OFF/ON normal and GC stress; unknown custom getter and noSuchMethod behavior unchanged; actual FileExplorer compile/GUI, before size/performance claims.
